title: Fix three bugs in a Rust word frequency counter
description: Fix bugs in WordFreq: add increments by 2 instead of 1, top_n sorts ascending instead of descending, total_words counts unique words instead of total count.

task_spec.prompt:
Fix three bugs in src/lib.rs:
1. add: change `*count += 2` to `*count += 1`
2. top_n: sort descending — replace `pairs.sort_by_key(|&(_, v)| v)` with `pairs.sort_by(|a, b| b.1.cmp(&a.1))`
3. total_words: return `self.counts.values().sum()` instead of `self.counts.len()`
All 3 cargo test cases must pass.
followup_prompts: Run `cargo test --quiet` to check the current state. Walk me through what bugs you found and fixed. If any tests are still failing, show me the errors and fix them.
Final verification: run `cargo test --quiet` and confirm a completely clean build. Every test must pass — if any are still red, fix them now.
